description: Defines classes for Radio Unit (RU) adapters in the upper PHY layer, including downlink, uplink request, uplink, timing, and error adapters, with methods for handling data and connecting handlers.

classes.name: upper_phy_ru_dl_rg_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for downlink data from Radio Unit to upper PHY.

classes.name: upper_phy_ru_ul_request_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for uplink requests from upper PHY to Radio Unit.

classes.name: upper_phy_ru_ul_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for uplink symbols and PRACH window data from Radio Unit.

classes.name: upper_phy_ru_timing_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for timing notifications from Radio Unit.

classes.name: upper_phy_ru_error_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for error notifications from Radio Unit.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends downlink data using the connected handler.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects the adapter to a specific handler.

methods.name: map_handler
methods.description: Maps a handler to a specific sector.

methods.name: on_ul_half_slot_boundary
methods.description: Handles uplink half slot boundary notifications.

methods.name: on_ul_full_slot_boundary
methods.description: Handles uplink full slot boundary notifications.
